explanation: `var` is function-scoped, not block-scoped, so all three closures pushed into `counters` share the same `i` binding. By the time any of them is invoked, the loop has finished and `i` is 3, so every counter returns 3 instead of the expected 0, 1, 2. Using `let` would give each iteration its own binding and fix it.
prompt: Will calling each function in `counters` return 0, 1, 2 as intended?
